calling all captains.bio: Edmonton band Calling All Captains is a Canadian punk-rock group that combines post-hardcore grit, pop-punk melody and emotionally direct alternative-rock songwriting.

cindy lee.bio: Cindy Lee is the experimental pop and songwriting project of Canadian musician Patrick Flegel, formerly of Women, combining lo-fi pop, doo-wop, noise and glam-inflected performance.

citizen kane.bio: Toronto duo Citizen Kane is a Canadian underground hip-hop group whose late-1990s releases earned back-to-back Juno nominations and documented the city's emerging independent rap scene.

city fidelia.bio: Ottawa rapper, community builder and entrepreneur City Fidelia, born Luigi Fidelia, pairs Canadian hip-hop with a strong focus on independent creative infrastructure and community development.

clairmont the second.bio: Toronto rapper, producer and director Clairmont The Second is a self-produced Canadian hip-hop artist whose independent albums have earned Juno, Polaris and SOCAN recognition.

da grass roots music.bio: Toronto production team Da Grassroots helped shape Canadian hip-hop through sample-driven production for artists including Ghetto Concept, Choclair and Saukrates and the album Passage Through Time.

da grassroots.bio: Toronto production team Da Grassroots helped shape Canadian hip-hop through sample-driven production for artists including Ghetto Concept, Choclair and Saukrates and the album Passage Through Time.

dan-e-o.bio: Toronto rapper, producer and actor Dan-e-o, born Daniel Faraldo, is a veteran of Canadian hip-hop and a member of the Scarborough collectives Monolith and Perfeck Strangers.

dan kanter.bio: Ottawa-born, Toronto-based musician Dan Kanter is a Canadian multi-instrumentalist, songwriter, producer and musical director known for extensive work with Justin Bieber and other major artists.

dan talevski.bio: Georgetown, Ontario-born singer-songwriter Dan Talevski is a Canadian pop artist who first developed an audience online before breaking through with polished romantic pop and dance-pop singles.

dallas smith.bio: Langley-born singer Dallas Smith is a Canadian vocalist who moved from fronting the rock band Default into a highly successful contemporary-country solo career.

daniela andrade.bio: Honduran-Canadian singer, songwriter and producer Daniela Andrade blends intimate vocals, bilingual writing, R&B, jazz and experimental electronic production in an independent catalogue.

death from above 1979.bio: Toronto duo Death From Above 1979 combines distorted bass, drums and vocals in a high-impact Canadian mix of dance-punk, noise rock and hard rock.

default.bio: Vancouver band Default is a Canadian hard-rock and post-grunge group best known for the early-2000s hit Wasting My Time and for launching singer Dallas Smith's later country career.

divine brown.bio: Toronto singer Divine Brown is a Canadian R&B, soul and jazz vocalist known for the radio hit Old Skool Love and an award-winning career spanning music and theatre.

dizzy.bio: Oshawa indie-pop band Dizzy is a Canadian group led by vocalist Katie Munshaw whose debut album Baby Teeth won the Juno Award for Alternative Album of the Year.

dj grouch.bio: Toronto DJ and producer DJ Grouch is a longtime Canadian hip-hop figure whose career spans club culture, touring, production, music education and work with Maestro Fresh Wes and Los Poetas.

djkemo.bio: Vancouver DJ and producer Kemo is a Juno-winning co-founder of Rascalz and a central architect of West Coast Canadian hip-hop, including production on Northern Touch.

dru.bio: Toronto singer-songwriter Dru, born Andrew Grange, is a Canadian R&B vocalist who first fronted In Essence before building a Juno-winning solo career.
